Thanks for the quick demo yesterday — Aurum is ready to move forward with Redwood as a vendor for our integration work. Our AP team asked me to collect the following before we issue the first PO: 

- Official vendor/legal name, VAT ID, and registered address (we need exact matches to our records).
- Bank details for EUR payouts (IBAN + BIC).
- Preferred invoice flow: standard vendor invoice or self-billing (Aurum can accept self-bill if Redwood agrees).
- Example invoice showing line-level PO references and breakdown by product code.

I attached our vendor enrollment form (we will still need a signed W-8/W-9 equivalent if requested). Also attaching a sample PO format used by our procurement system (AUR-12345).

Can you send the AP packet we require from Redwood and confirm whether Redwood can accept self-bill + remit to a single IBAN? If self-billing is possible, we will set up an automated feed and expect invoices to include: PO number, PO line number, line-level VAT treatment, and unit/service codes.

Best,

Hi Lena,

Short note on VAT / self-billing feasibility from Redwood's side:

- We can enable self-billing for EU customers where Aurum issues an approval that we can rely on; however, we need a signed self-billing agreement and confirmation of Aurum's VAT ID and tax representative if applicable.
- For German customers, we typically require the VAT ID match and (for reverse-charge scenarios) a PO line indicating reverse-charge treatment. If Aurum wants us to net VAT on invoices, please indicate that on the PO lines.
- Line-level requirements: PO number, PO line ID, product code, quantity (or unit), net amount, VAT rate (or "reverse-charge" flag), and total.

Ben, can you paste the PO->invoice mapping and any product-code conventions we should send to Aurum for their ingestion?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole

Hi Lena — following up with the technical mapping for Aurum's procurement system. Below is a concise mapping we can provide as a CSV or XML snippet for your integration team.

PO -> Invoice field mapping (high level):
- PO number -> invoice.header.purchase_order_number
- PO line -> invoice.lines.po_line_id
- Product code -> invoice.lines.product_code (Redwood uses 'RDW-' prefix)
- Description -> invoice.lines.description
- Unit -> invoice.lines.unit_of_measure
- Quantity -> invoice.lines.quantity
- Unit price (net) -> invoice.lines.unit_price_net
- VAT code -> invoice.lines.vat_rate_or_reverse_charge_flag
- Line total (net) -> invoice.lines.line_total_net
- Invoice total (gross) -> invoice.total_gross

Notes / preferences:
- We can include a 'product_code' column with RDW codes (e.g., RDW-SUB-01 for subscription, RDW-USG-01 for usage tokens) if that helps your ingestion.
- For self-bill: please include a 'self_bill_approved' flag on your PO metadata; once we receive that we will mark invoices as self-billed and include the signed agreement reference.
- Attachment handling: Redwood will send a PDF copy of every invoice; if you prefer an EDI feed, we can add an SFTP endpoint.

Next steps we propose:
1) Aurum confirms format (CSV/EDI/XML) and whether they want product codes.
2) Aurum returns signed self-bill agreement (if opting in).
3) We run a test invoice (we'll send an invoice referencing AUR-TEST-001) and Aurum confirms ingestion.

I attached a sample PO (po_example_AUR-12345.pdf) and our sample invoice. Happy to hop on a 30-min call with your AP/IT to walk through the mapping.

Best,

Ben Carter
Payments & Onboarding Specialist | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
